attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

mcd18-1.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

mcd18-2.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

mcd18-3.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

mcd18-4.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

mcd18-5.flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

mcd18-6.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd18-7.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

attacks.name: Searching Magnet
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Metal Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

mcd18-8.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dratini, a Dragonair, and a Dragonite, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

mcd18-9.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

mcd18-10.flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

mcd18-11.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

attacks.name: Code Check
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards.

mcd18-12.flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.
